parole.significato: honorific or endearing word for (male) family members; such as older brother, uncle, cousin or another respected, older…
parole.testo: * Svane suggests a borrowing from Serbo-Croatian baca, a children's pronunciation of braca (“older brother”). * Meyer and Çabej link it to baç (“head shepherd”) (compare baci). * Another possible source is Turkish bacı (“sister”). * Orel considers it an inherited word from Proto-Albanian *batja, rel
